description: One row of evidence.jsonl. One published record: a variant reported in carriers in one paper.

as_written.description: The variant exactly as the paper writes it
as_written.title: As Written

citation.description: Short citation: first author, journal, year, PMID, DOI
citation.title: Citation

confidence.description: high, medium or low, as assigned at extraction
confidence.title: Confidence

doi.description: DOI of the paper, if known
doi.title: Doi

evidence_quotes.description: Verbatim sentences from the paper supporting the record; joined with ' | ' in the CSV. Excerpts under the article's copyright, not CC BY
evidence_quotes.title: Evidence Quotes

extracted_by.description: The model that extracted the record
extracted_by.title: Extracted By

figure_sourced.description: The record rests on a machine transcription of a figure
figure_sourced.title: Figure Sourced

functional_evidence.description: One-sentence summary of functional work on the variant in this paper; machine-written, not a quote
functional_evidence.title: Functional Evidence

hgvs_c.description: Coding-DNA HGVS if the paper gives it or it is unambiguous; empty if not
hgvs_c.title: Hgvs C

hgvs_p.description: Protein HGVS if the paper gives it; empty if not
hgvs_p.title: Hgvs P

inh_de_novo_assumed.description: Probands called de novo without parental testing described
inh_de_novo_assumed.title: Inh De Novo Assumed

inh_de_novo_confirmed.description: Probands whose variant is de novo with both parents tested
inh_de_novo_confirmed.title: Inh De Novo Confirmed

inh_inherited.description: Probands who inherited the variant from a parent
inh_inherited.title: Inh Inherited

inh_unknown.description: Probands whose inheritance is not reported
inh_unknown.title: Inh Unknown

n_families.description: Kindreds with the variant in this paper; 0 when carriers came from screening a cohort and no family was studied
n_families.title: N Families

n_probands.description: Unrelated index cases carrying the variant in this paper (one per family)
n_probands.title: N Probands

n_tested.description: Everyone the study screened or sequenced; 0 means not stated
n_tested.title: N Tested

n_total_carriers.description: All reported carriers including relatives; empty if not stated
n_total_carriers.title: N Total Carriers

phenotype_details.description: The phenotype as reported, including age at onset if stated
phenotype_details.title: Phenotype Details

phenotype_systems.description: Organ systems affected in at least one carrier, comma-separated: cerebrovascular, small_vessel, renal_hanac, ocular, muscle, other
phenotype_systems.title: Phenotype Systems

pmcid.description: PubMed Central ID of the full text that was read
pmcid.title: Pmcid

pmid.description: PubMed ID of the paper the record comes from
pmid.title: Pmid

prior_report_reason.description: Why the record is marked as a prior report
prior_report_reason.title: Prior Report Reason

quotes_grounded.description: Every quote was found verbatim in the paper's text
quotes_grounded.title: Quotes Grounded

record_key.description: Stable key: PMID, position in the paper's records, and a short content hash
record_key.title: Record Key

reported_classification.description: The authors' own classification, verbatim; empty if none. An excerpt under the article's copyright, not CC BY
reported_classification.title: Reported Classification

review_flags.description: Why the record is queued for a person, comma-separated; empty if not
review_flags.title: Review Flags

reviewer_problem.description: The reviewer's stated problem, if it disputed the record
reviewer_problem.title: Reviewer Problem

reviewer_verdict.description: Outcome of the adversarial review, checked against the text: upheld, disputed, unverifiable, dispute not grounded, or not reviewed
reviewer_verdict.title: Reviewer Verdict

same_family_as_prior_report.description: The paper says this family or proband was reported before; counts may overlap with that paper
same_family_as_prior_report.title: Same Family As Prior Report

transcript_if_stated.description: Reference transcript the paper names; empty if none
transcript_if_stated.title: Transcript If Stated

variant_type.description: missense_glycine, missense_other, splice, nonsense, frameshift, inframe_indel, intronic, utr, deletion_cnv or other
variant_type.title: Variant Type

title: EvidenceRow
